description: Nieuwendammerdijk 300-308 (2019-12-12 strip): two-storey brick pairs 10.4 m wide under a cream cornice slab at 7.55 m (strip re-taken with --camera-height=2.75), five regular axes of tall white-framed windows (1.4 m wide, 2.3 m high upstairs), a string course at 3.9 m, one pedimented dormer over the middle axis; the door in the middle axis with a balcony over it

match.note: BAG 1955 on all five (rebuilt); 3DBAG eaves 7.5-9.0 m, roof 10.6-11.1 m

pediment-dormer.note: one cream pedimented dormer over the middle axis, 1.6 m wide, 8.2-10.1 m

door-centre.note: door in the middle axis under a balcony on corbels

rhythm.roofline: cream cornice slab, dark tile roof, one pedimented dormer

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2019-12-12 re-taken with --camera-height=2.75, 40 px/m, 1 m grid: pand 10.4 m; upper windows sill 3.85 m head 6.1 m, 1.4 m wide at 2.1 m pitch; ground sill 0.25 m head 2.5 m; string course 3.2 m; cream cornice 6.85-7.55 m; roof 7.6-8.9 m; pediment dormer 1.6 m wide to 9.7 m

schemaLimits: balcony on corbels over the door
pilaster strips at the party walls
